complete_selected_source.greek: καὶ μέντοι καὶ φακῆν ἔφαμεν ὁμοίωϲ κράμβη χρῆναι ϲκευάζειν, ἀμφότερα καὶ αὐτὴν ἐργάζεϲθαι δυναμένην, ὑπαγωγήν τε καὶ ϲτάλϲιν γαϲτρόϲ. ὀνομάζεται δ’ ἡ οὕτωϲ ϲκευαϲθεῖϲα δίϲεφθοϲ καὶ κράμβη καὶ φακῆ. καὶ κρόμυον δὲ καὶ πράϲον καὶ πολὺ μᾶλλον ἀμπελόπραϲόν τε καὶ ϲκόροδον, ὅ τι τ’ ἂν ἄλλο βουληθῇϲ ἐπὶ τοὐναντίον ἀποϲτῆϲαι τῆϲ ἀρχαίαϲ φύϲεωϲ, οὕτω ϲκεύαζε μεμνημένοϲ ἐκείνου πρὸ πάντων. ὡϲ οὐ χρὴ ψαύειν οὔτ’ ἀέροϲ οὔθ’ ὕδατοϲ ψυχροῦ τὸ δὶϲ ἑψόμενον· οὐκέτι γὰρ ἀκριβῶϲ γίγνεται τακερόν, οὐδ’ ἂν ἐπὶ πλεῖϲτον ἕψῃϲ, ἀλλὰ χρή, καθάπερ εἶπον ἀρτίωϲ, ἕτοιμον ἔχονταϲ ὕδωρ θερμόν, ἀνελκύϲανταϲ ἐκ τοῦ προτέρου μεταβάλλειν εὐθέωϲ εἰϲ ἐκεῖνο.
complete_selected_source.english_working_translation: Indeed, we also said that lentil soup should be prepared like cabbage, since it too can bring about both evacuation and checking of the belly. Both cabbage and lentil soup prepared in this way are called twice-boiled. Prepare onion and leek too, and much more wild leek and garlic, and whatever else you wish to change toward the opposite of its original nature, in this way, remembering this above all: the thing being twice boiled must touch neither air nor cold water. For it no longer becomes properly soft, even if you boil it for a very long time. Rather, as I have just said, have hot water ready, draw it from the former water and immediately transfer it into that.
complete_selected_source.translation_status: Own source-side semantic translation; not a target reading or certified modern pharmacology.

continuous_working_reading: Earlier we said that lentil soup should be prepared like cabbage; it too can cause both checking of the belly and evacuation, the same evacuation use already mentioned. Both foods prepared in that way are called twice-boiled. Prepare onion and leek, especially wild leek and garlic, and any other food you wish to change toward the opposite of its original nature in that way. Remember above all: food intended for this two-boil preparation must touch neither air nor cold water. After such contact the same food no longer becomes properly soft, even with very prolonged boiling in the same replacement water. As just said, have that water ready and hot, draw the food from the former liquid and immediately transfer it into that water. The two distant THIS_USE references both point back to the initial evacuation capability, not the local reboiling instruction.
